column8: NOT LOCATED. Dimensions supplied in the project brief (3.0 mm OD silicone tube, 1 mm wall, 1100 mm active length, 18 mm ID glass outer tube, 28 C, pH 7) could not be confirmed against a primary Methods section; nearby lab MABRs report materially different geometries (e.g. 350 mm length, 4 mm OD / 3 mm ID), and a 3.0 mm OD with a 1 mm wall implies a 1 mm bore. Every row citing this source is provisional.

column2: Nafion-117 Co-60 irradiation study (membrane radiation stability)
column8: NOT VERIFIED against the primary report. Cited only as the applicable benchmark for NAFION; it establishes nothing about silicone. Its design varied atmosphere (air vs sealed with deionized water) and dose rate (1 vs 460 krad/h) independently, which is why total dose alone is an insufficient condition descriptor.

Arithmetic from the repeat unit, M = 74.1539 g/mol. A PROXY only: commercial cured silicone tubing contains silica filler, curing agents and additives, so this is not a certified membrane composition.
